notes.title: Update 1.00.0
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings![/b]
We’re excited to let you know that – [b]Territors[/b] Has Arrived! Give it a try and let us know what you think!

[h2]New content:[/h2]
- Added complete new "Final challenge" setting.
- Duel progress steps are now shown for better orientation.
- Added more merging options for Neutrons.
- Added confirmation screen for the "New Game" option in Settings.
- Added confirmation screen for the "Retreat" option during Duel.
- Improved the "Card" section of the Tutorial.


[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
- Removed AI abilitites and bonuses used (generated) in previous duel. Each duel now comes with its own unique cards configuration.
- Fixed a merging issue that only worked in a specific drag-and-drop order.
- Updated particle descriptions.
- Various small fixes and tweaks. 


Enjoy the game, and stay tuned for more updates, cause the release isn’t the end, there’s more coming soon!

notes.title: Update 0.97.3
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings![/b]
The new update that brings a lot of changes to the game is here!

[h2]New content:[/h2]
[list]
[*] "Single" and "Dual" game modes, where the entire duel was played with one or two cards, have been replaced with "Static" and "Dynamic" game modes, which bring much greater variability to the game, as these modes involve either a fixed or changing number of playing cards after each battle within duel. (Demo included!)
[*] 6 new card levels have been added. These levels determine the possible abilities and bonuses that can be applied to a card based on its level. (Demo included!)
[*] AI logic improvements. The differences between challenges are now greater, and the AI also uses all available card upgrades. (Demo included!)
[*] Completely revamped bonuses, which are no longer fixed to certain cards, but can now be dynamically selected from different categories, similarly to how abilities work. (Demo included!)
[*] Partial calculation of mercury in a given battle has been added, which is then included in the total score. It is much easier to see the outcome of the battle within the duel. (Demo included!)
[*] Graphical adjustments to the game field, with a more logical rearrangement of elements. (Demo included!)
[*] 2 new traits have been added for enemy leaders.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the possible issue of a drawn card getting stuck when using a combination of LMB and RMB buttons during gameplay.
[*] Fixed Credits projection.
[*] Fixed upgrade prices during recalculations in the Cauldron configuration.
[/list]

Enjoy the game, and stay tuned for more updates in the future!

notes.title: Territors DEMO available NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458489/0c609623cd146742aff1356f0e28a8bb75295888.jpg[/img]

We're excited to share that the demo for our upcoming game is now [b]LIVE[/b]!

You can check it out and play the demo by visiting the Steam page for [b]Territors[/b]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3470920/Territors/

This demo is designed to be compact and focused. We want it to be enjoyable without spoiling the full game. The most important part of this demo is that it helps us understand how to improve the full game, so please give it a spin and let us know what you think.

A huge thank you for all your support!
